root_cause.text: The driver incorrectly assumed that buf2 of non-final descriptors in split header mode is always fully filled with payload, causing miscalculation of buf2 length when the hardware fails to populate buf2 in the first descriptor, leading to invalid DMA cache synchronization on wrong memory addresses.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `stmmac_rx_buf2_len()` to change the condition from `if (status & rx_not_ls)` (which returns full buffer size for all non-last descriptors) to `if (priv->plat->core_type != DWMAC_CORE_GMAC4 && (status & rx_not_ls))` (which only assumes full buffer for non-GMAC4 hardware). The fix uses the PL bit-field in RDES3 register for all GMAC4 descriptors by calculating `plen - len` regardless of descriptor position, because in rare cases GMAC4 hardware does not fill buf2 of the first descriptor, making the old assumption invalid and causing the oops when attempting to sync an invalid DMA address.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix GMAC4 split header buffer length calculation by excluding GMAC4 from the early return optimization and always using plen-based calculation to handle cases where hardware does not fill buf2 of the first descriptor.
intent_record.what: Added comprehensive multi-line comment explaining GMAC4 split header behavior, modified the condition from `if (status & rx_not_ls)` to `if (priv->plat->core_type != DWMAC_CORE_GMAC4 && (status & rx_not_ls))`, removed the 'Last descriptor' comment, and added a 'GMAC4 or last descriptor' comment before the plen calculation.
intent_record.how: The change fixes buffer length calculation for GMAC4 hardware with split header mode enabled. Previously, the code assumed buf2 was always fully filled when not the last descriptor, which caused incorrect length calculations and oops errors on GMAC4. Now it only applies the early return optimization for non-GMAC4 hardware, while GMAC4 always uses the corrected `plen - len` calculation that accounts for the hardware quirk where buf2 of the first descriptor may not be filled.

grouping_result.intent: Fix GMAC4 split header buffer length calculation by excluding GMAC4 from the early return optimization and always using plen-based calculation to handle cases where hardware does not fill buf2 of the first descriptor.

It specifically handles the case where hardware fails to populate buf2 in the first descriptor by excluding GMAC4 from an early return optimization and ensuring plen-based calculation is always used, which prevents the miscalculation that led to invalid DMA cache synchronization.

This condition treats all non-final descriptors uniformly by returning full buffer size, but fails to account for GMAC4's behavior where buf2 may not be filled in the first descriptor, requiring plen-based calculation instead.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement returns the full DMA buffer size for all non-final descriptors without considering actual payload length. In GMAC4 split header mode, when hardware fails to populate buf2 in the first descriptor, this causes buf2 length to be miscalculated as the full buffer size instead of the actual payload length, leading to invalid DMA cache synchronization on wrong memory addresses.

This condition uniformly treats all non-final descriptors by triggering the early return of full buffer size, but fails to account for GMAC4-specific behavior where buf2 may not be filled in the first descriptor. This requires GMAC4 to use plen-based calculation instead of the full buffer size assumption.
